name: @mohou/gitlab-mcp

tools.name: gitlab_whoami
tools.description: Get the authenticated user. Call this first: it is the cheapest way to prove the token and base URL work before any write.

tools.name: gitlab_server_version
tools.description: Get the GitLab version answering this token (GET /version). Confirms which version the instance is on, which matters because most public documentation describes newer releases.

tools.name: gitlab_raw_api
tools.description: Call any API v4 endpoint directly - the escape hatch for endpoints with no dedicated tool (issues, labels, pipelines, snippets, members). Prefer a dedicated tool when one exists: this one does no validation, so a wrong path or field is exactly what the instance receives.

query.description: query string parameters; values are stringified

tools.name: gitlab_project_get
tools.description: Get a project by id or path. Use it to turn a project name into the path the other tools take, and to read default_branch.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

tools.name: gitlab_project_search
tools.description: Search projects visible to this token by name. Use it when the exact project path is unknown.

page.description: 1-based page number; see pagination.nextPage in the result

perPage.description: items per page, max 100 (GitLab default is 20)

tools.name: gitlab_labels_list
tools.description: List a project's labels. Check here before setting labels: 11.3 creates an unknown label silently when the account may, and rejects it when the account may not.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

page.description: 1-based page number; see pagination.nextPage in the result

perPage.description: items per page, max 100 (GitLab default is 20)

tools.name: gitlab_users_search
tools.description: Find users by name or username. Needed because 11.3 assigns and filters by numeric user id and never by username.

page.description: 1-based page number; see pagination.nextPage in the result

perPage.description: items per page, max 100 (GitLab default is 20)

tools.name: gitlab_branches_list
tools.description: List a project's branches. Useful before gitlab_mr_create to confirm the source branch exists and to find the target branch.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

page.description: 1-based page number; see pagination.nextPage in the result

perPage.description: items per page, max 100 (GitLab default is 20)

tools.name: gitlab_file_get
tools.description: Read one file from the repository at a ref. Defaults to the project default branch - pass ref=<the MR source_branch> to read the file as the merge request sees it. Output is capped, and a truncated read says so.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

path.description: repository-relative file path, e.g. 'src/app.ts' (no leading slash)

ref.description: branch, tag or commit SHA; defaults to the project default branch

maxChars.description: cap on returned characters; the file itself may be longer

tools.name: gitlab_mr_list
tools.description: List a project's merge requests. Defaults to state=opened because the raw API would return every state at once. This version has no reviewers or draft filter - read work_in_progress on each item instead.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

scope.description: created_by_me / assigned_to_me / all; combined with author_id or assignee_id

author_id.description: filter: author numeric user id (find it with gitlab_users_search); 0 unassigns

assignee_id.description: filter: assignee numeric user id (find it with gitlab_users_search); 0 unassigns

page.description: 1-based page number; see pagination.nextPage in the result

perPage.description: items per page, max 100 (GitLab default is 20)

tools.name: gitlab_mr_get
tools.description: Get one merge request. Read state before anything else: only an opened merge request can be merged, and a merged one still reports merge_status can_be_merged. work_in_progress says whether it is a draft.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

iid.description: project-scoped internal id - the number in !123 for a merge request or #123 for an issue, not the global id

tools.name: gitlab_mr_changes
tools.description: The merge request diff, summarised per file: status, added/removed line counts and a capped patch. Read this before commenting on a line, and to learn which paths and lines exist. Use path to pull one file's patch at a larger cap.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

iid.description: project-scoped internal id - the number in !123 for a merge request or #123 for an issue, not the global id

maxPatchChars.description: patch characters per file; a cut patch sets patchTruncated

maxFiles.description: files to include; the rest are counted in stats.omittedFiles

tools.name: gitlab_mr_create
tools.description: Create a merge request from source_branch into target_branch. On 11.3 there is no reviewers attribute (assign instead) and no draft parameter: pass draft:true and the required "WIP: " title prefix is applied for you. Creating an MR whose branches already have an open one fails with 409 - update that one instead.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

draft.description: mark as work in progress ("WIP: " title prefix)

assignee_id.description: assignee numeric user id (find it with gitlab_users_search); 0 unassigns

labels.description: label names; a label that does not exist yet is created by GitLab when the caller has permission

milestone_id.description: global milestone id, not the project-scoped iid

remove_source_branch.description: remove the source branch when this MR merges

squash.description: squash commits when this MR merges

tools.name: gitlab_mr_update
tools.description: Update a merge request. Pass draft to set or clear the "WIP: " prefix (when no title is given the current title is read first). labels:[] clears all labels and assignee_id:0 unassigns - omitting a field leaves it alone.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

iid.description: project-scoped internal id - the number in !123 for a merge request or #123 for an issue, not the global id

draft.description: set or clear the "WIP: " title prefix

assignee_id.description: assignee numeric user id (find it with gitlab_users_search); 0 unassigns

labels.description: replaces the whole label set; [] clears it

state_event.description: close or reopen the merge request

discussion_locked.description: when locked, only project members can comment or resolve

tools.name: gitlab_mr_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on the merge request itself. For a comment on a specific line of the diff, use gitlab_mr_comment_on_line so it appears in the changed line's thread.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

iid.description: project-scoped internal id - the number in !123 for a merge request or #123 for an issue, not the global id

tools.name: gitlab_mr_merge
tools.description: Merge a merge request. The merge request must be opened - merging a merged or closed one fails. It fails with 405 while it is not mergeable (conflicts, or a required pipeline still running) and with 409 when the source branch moved since you read it, so read the merge request first and pass its sha to pin the merge.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

iid.description: project-scoped internal id - the number in !123 for a merge request or #123 for an issue, not the global id

sha.description: source-branch HEAD as you read it; a mismatch is rejected rather than merging newer commits

merge_when_pipeline_succeeds.description: schedule the merge instead of merging now

tools.name: gitlab_mr_pipelines
tools.description: List the pipelines recorded against this merge request. Read before merging: 11.3 refuses the merge while one is running or failed.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

iid.description: project-scoped internal id - the number in !123 for a merge request or #123 for an issue, not the global id

page.description: 1-based page number; see pagination.nextPage in the result

perPage.description: items per page, max 100 (GitLab default is 20)

tools.name: gitlab_mr_versions
tools.description: List the diff versions of a merge request, newest first as GitLab returns them. Only needed to debug comment positions - gitlab_mr_comment_on_line resolves them itself.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

iid.description: project-scoped internal id - the number in !123 for a merge request or #123 for an issue, not the global id

page.description: 1-based page number; see pagination.nextPage in the result

perPage.description: items per page, max 100 (GitLab default is 20)

tools.name: gitlab_mr_discussions
tools.description: List the discussion threads of a merge request, with each diff comment's file and line. System notes are filtered out by default and `resolved` is derived from the thread's notes, so the returned page can be shorter than pagination.total (which is GitLab's raw count).

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

iid.description: project-scoped internal id - the number in !123 for a merge request or #123 for an issue, not the global id

includeSystem.description: keep GitLab-generated notes (label, push, state changes)

onlyUnresolved.description: keep only threads that have resolvable notes and none of them resolved

maxBodyChars.description: per comment; longer text is marked as truncated

page.description: 1-based page number; see pagination.nextPage in the result

perPage.description: items per page, max 100 (GitLab default is 20)

tools.name: gitlab_mr_comment_on_line
tools.description: Comment on one line of the merge request diff, as a normal review comment. Give the path exactly as gitlab_mr_changes reports it and the line number in that side of the file. The required base/start/head SHAs and the old-side line number are resolved from the merge request's latest diff version, so a stale SHA or a line that is not in the diff is reported instead of being sent. The result carries discussion_id - pass it to gitlab_mr_reply to continue the thread.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

iid.description: project-scoped internal id - the number in !123 for a merge request or #123 for an issue, not the global id

path.description: repository-relative file path, e.g. 'src/app.ts' (no leading slash)

side.description: 'new' = the file after the change (added and unchanged lines), 'old' = the file before it (removed and unchanged lines)

tools.name: gitlab_mr_reply
tools.description: Reply inside an existing discussion thread. Use it to answer a review comment instead of starting a second thread on the same line.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

iid.description: project-scoped internal id - the number in !123 for a merge request or #123 for an issue, not the global id

discussion_id.description: from gitlab_mr_discussions or a previous comment_on_line result

tools.name: gitlab_mr_resolve
tools.description: Resolve or unresolve a discussion thread. This is how review state is recorded on CE 11.3, which has no approve API. Reply to the thread first if the resolution needs an explanation.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

iid.description: project-scoped internal id - the number in !123 for a merge request or #123 for an issue, not the global id

tools.name: gitlab_project_issues
tools.description: List a project's issues. Read-only extra: this file declares the endpoints the merge-request tools do not cover, so they cost no code.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

page.description: 1-based page number; see pagination.nextPage in the result

perPage.description: items per page, max 100 (GitLab default is 20)

tools.name: gitlab_issue_get
tools.description: Get one issue by its project-scoped iid.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

iid.description: project-scoped internal id - the number in !123 for a merge request or #123 for an issue, not the global id

tools.name: gitlab_project_members
tools.description: List a project's members with their access level and numeric user id - the ids gitlab_mr_create/update take as assignee_id.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

page.description: 1-based page number; see pagination.nextPage in the result

perPage.description: items per page, max 100 (GitLab default is 20)

tools.name: gitlab_project_pipelines
tools.description: List a project's pipelines, optionally filtered by ref or status. On 11.3 a merge request's own pipelines come from gitlab_mr_pipelines.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

ref.description: branch name, tag or commit SHA

page.description: 1-based page number; see pagination.nextPage in the result

perPage.description: items per page, max 100 (GitLab default is 20)

tools.name: gitlab_pipeline_jobs
tools.description: List the jobs of a pipeline with their status, stage and failure reason. Job logs are text, not JSON, so they are not reachable from this JSON layer.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

page.description: 1-based page number; see pagination.nextPage in the result

perPage.description: items per page, max 100 (GitLab default is 20)

tools.name: gitlab_commit_list
tools.description: List repository commits on a ref. Use it to see what a merge request's source branch contains beyond the diff.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

ref.description: branch name, tag or commit SHA

page.description: 1-based page number; see pagination.nextPage in the result

perPage.description: items per page, max 100 (GitLab default is 20)

tools.name: gitlab_tags_list
tools.description: List repository tags.

project.description: project id ('42') or full path ('group/subgroup/app'); a path is URL-encoded for you

page.description: 1-based page number; see pagination.nextPage in the result

perPage.description: items per page, max 100 (GitLab default is 20)

tools.description: List the projects of a group (including its subgroups), to find a project path from a group.

perPage.description: items per page, max 100 (GitLab default is 20)
